mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, menu_name, parent_id, order_num, path, component, query, is_frame, is_cache, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 0 AND menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY parent_id, order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.query, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
